title: A note without a work ref, right after add, lands on the new unclaimed item instead of the held focus
outcome: A note without a work ref, right after add, lands on the new unclaimed item instead of the held focus
acceptance: A test covers add followed by a bare note and a bare gate

After a holder adds an independent root while holding another item, a note or gate without a work ref still targets the held item, or is refused naming both items; it never records silently on the new item

completion.summary: A bare note, gate, evaluate, update or done now acts on the ambient focus only when this session holds it or holds nothing else. Otherwise it is refused with work_implicit_target_conflict and nothing is recorded. The refusal names the focus (with its state) and up to 3 held items, with explicit commands. add keeps focusing what it creates, and bare handoff is unguarded by design. Landed as e78ef5e and installed (build f4b40c7a…). Independent evaluation passed both criteria.
